segments.name: Commercial Services
products: regional toll transponder installation and vehicle association
segments.description: Provides automated toll and violations management plus title and registration solutions to rental car companies, commercial fleets and fleet management companies, mainly in North America.
segments.evidence: Commercial Services provides automated toll and violations management and title and registration solutions to RACs, Direct Fleets, FMCs, and other large fleet owners primarily in North America.

segments.name: Government Solutions
segments.description: Installs and manages photo enforcement and automated safety systems for states, municipalities, counties, school districts and law enforcement agencies.
segments.evidence: Our Government Solutions segment provides photo enforcement automated safety solutions to states, municipalities, counties, school districts, and law enforcement agencies of all sizes, primarily in the United States, Canada, and Australia.

segments.name: Parking Solutions
segments.description: Provides end-to-end commercial parking management software, hardware and transaction processing to universities, municipalities, healthcare facilities and commercial operators.
segments.evidence: Parking Solutions provides end-to-end commercial parking management solutions to approximately 1,775 customers in the university, municipal, healthcare, and commercial operator markets, as of December 31, 2025.

revenueModel.text: Fleet owners, government agencies and parking operators pay for toll and violations management, automated enforcement and parking services, typically when they use them.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company determined its performance obligation is a distinct stand-ready obligation, as there is an unspecified quantity of services provided that does not diminish, and the customer is being charged only when it uses the Company's services, such as toll payment and title and registration.
